evidenceBoundary.exact: Current ordered source calls, generated field destinations, closed source contexts and current union routes; complete selected static allocation/constructor/Register instruction windows and raw key/element pointer joins.
evidenceBoundary.direct: Under normal non-null allocation and constructor return, the original object reference reaches Register with the exact key used by each source field.
evidenceBoundary.conditional: Typed non-null allocation, normal constructor return and ordinary Win64 stack/nonvolatile behavior are assumed. No actual initialization/provider result is observed.
evidenceBoundary.structuralOnly: Independent Object/int compiled formatter candidates do not establish runtime code selection for the concrete condition or DamageType classes.
evidenceBoundary.unresolved: Selected list/element formatter bodies, positive collection grammar, independent recursive children, maintained parent dispatcher integration, complete family/root admission and actual gameplay conditions/effects.
